title: Concept: Dockerfile served from the web root
description: A Dockerfile discloses the exact base image, the package set and the build arguments. Build arguments are the usual place a token is passed at build time, and they are recorded in image history as well as in the file.
applicability: Responses that serve the build context or a misconfigured static path from a container image.
risk: The caller fingerprints the runtime, learns which packages and versions it carries, and reads any build argument that was passed.
